import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('EXPERIMENTS/049-lockfile-closure')
res = json.loads((root/'results.json').read_text())
# map repo -> row (has old/head sha, date, path)
by_repo = {r['repo']: r for r in res['rows'] if r.get('status')=='ok'}
manifest = {'generated': '2026-10-07', 'files': []}
for f in sorted((root/'raw').glob('*.txt')):
    stem = f.stem  # e.g. pallets_flask_old
    repo_slug, kind = stem.rsplit('_', 1)
    repo = repo_slug.replace('_', '/', 1)
    row = by_repo[repo]
    snap = row['head'] if kind == 'head' else row['old']
    url = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{repo}/{snap['sha']}/{row['path']}"
    data = f.read_bytes()
    manifest['files'].append({
        'repo': repo, 'path': row['path'], 'snapshot': kind,
        'commit_sha': snap['sha'], 'commit_date': snap['date'],
        'url': url, 'bytes': len(data),
        'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        'file': f'raw/{f.name}',
    })
(root/'raw-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+'\n')
print('manifest entries:', len(manifest['files']))
print('total bytes:', sum(e['bytes'] for e in manifest['files']))

stg agent usability experiment: 4 scenarios tested across single-line, adjacent-modifications, scattered-modifications, and stg-vs-git-add-p comparison.
